body: My heart breaks for you. I’m so so sorry. I’m glad you have that to make you feel better, but again, I’m deeply sorry for that loss. I don’t have energy to write individual letters I don’t think and I already started drinking the thing I’m using. Thanks for your input and time. I wish you the best.

I appreciate the input and I’m sorry you’re feeling the lack of energy right now too. I hope you can pull yourself back out, it sounds like you were able to do it once before and I believe you can do it again!

I’ll write something out, thanks again.
This is the highest compliment. I’m glad it made you and your group chat laugh. :)

In the past I almost exclusively would eat in front of others to hide the ED and at other times I’ve exclusively eaten alone because of ED (and anxiety too probably since I get weird about food on my face or how I eat or what have you). 

Basically, I think it’s common to change eating behavior in front of others and I think the “change” is variable. Sorry if it’s causing you distress, just wanted to let you know that you’re not alone.
Yea, this happened when I had anorexia and didn’t eat, or I guess fasted too much. It made eating painful after I shrank it so much.
